faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the TGCAB Cooperative Intern position?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Cooperative Intern position at Telangana State Cooperative Bank is 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Cooperative Intern role?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an MBA or equivalent in relevant fields, or a 2-year PGDM accredited by AICTE/UGC. Proficiency in computers and Telugu is also essential.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Cooperative Intern recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is between 21 and 30 years as of 31st July 2026. Candidates born on or after 01-08-1996 and not later than 31-07-2005 are eligible.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Cooperative Intern position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration of Rs. 25,000/-. TA/DA will be provided on par with Staff Assistants.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Cooperative Intern post?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted offline via Speed Post to the address mentioned in the official notification.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for the Cooperative Intern recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the contract for the Cooperative Intern role?
faq.answer: The engagement of Cooperative Interns is for a period of one year.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection criteria for the Cooperative Intern position?
faq.answer: The selection process includes an interview and a merit list based on academic performance in SSC, 12th, Graduation, Post Graduation, and additional qualifications.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Telangana State Cooperative Bank: https://tgcab.bank.in.

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be provided to the Cooperative Interns?
faq.answer: Yes, TA/DA will be provided to the Cooperative Interns on par with the Staff Assistants of TGCAB.
